question: Related Questions Q. Hajj 1894 views Q. Hajj 2531 views Q. I had the LIC policy. On policy matured I got bonus and principal amount with interest. The bonus is separately mentioned. Can I use the principal amount and bonus for Haj purpose. 3839 views Q. I live in Jeddah with my wife. We went to perform Umra. We completed the Tawaf and Saee. After that, my wife wanted to cut her hair herself but I told her that only someone who has already got Halaqa can cut your hair. She waited for me so I can get my haircut and then cut her hair. After I had my Haircut, we discovered we did not have a scissors to cut her hair. We thought we can go home (Jeddah) and do that. Once we returned home, we kissed each other. Immediately after, she remembered that she needed to cut her hair. Now, please advise us if we should give any "Dum" having done this? If so, what should it be? and can we give Dum back in Pakistan where people need it the most? 9978 views Q. Performing Hajj while doing a job in Saudi Arabia 4239 views Q. visiting makkah without ihram(no intension of umrah) 22619 views Q. I wish to take my mother and wife for HAJJ . But I have some business problems and creditors to pay ( I am writing my problems below in detail) so I am not sure if MY HAJJ WILL BE IN ORDER . I am doing business in the family but due to some disputes our business is on closure and we have bank interest and creditors to pay. I want to settle all the creditors by selling our land to avoid the WRATH OF ALLAH SUBHANAHO TAALAH , but my other associates are not ready for this. As we are all blaming each other for the problems and nobody is interested in settling the business creditors / bank as they all want some money for themselves before they are ready to settle the accounts. The situation is not improving and I want to take my mother and wife for HAJJ with my own personal busines money . Can you please advice, in the light of the Shariat , am I allowed to perform the HAJJ in this situation and will it be in order ? May Allah give you the JAZAA for helping me in this matter. 1926 views Q. Haj Without Legal Govt Permission from Saudi Arabia for the Foreigners who are living inside Saudi Arabia... 3792 views Q. I did umra with very short hair. After that I went to the barber shop and he trimmed my hair. He didnot shave it. Since the hair was very short - so the trimming finished fast because only little hair could be cut. So, is there dam on me? Please explain 3687 views Q. Please give advice. One person making Umrah and after tawaf he removed hair before sa’i unintentionally. He should give dam. Second he is poor financially. Please advise. 2814 views Q. Ummrah and Hajj 2296 views Q. My question is keeping qarza we can do urmrha or not? 7006 views Q. aid intends to go for Haj along with her mother. But Zaid's wife(Rashidah) insists her husband not to go for any one of the following reasons. 1. Rashidah fears that her mother in law (Zaid's mother) would pass away due to her sickness. 2. Rashidah feels that she herself will not be more if she would stay without her husband.(Like more conservative women feel in India) Now Zaid is capable to bear the expenses for two. For him and for her mother. So in such case what should Zaid do? Whether he should go for Haj with her mother or not. And all advices failed to convince Rashida. 1598 views Q. Umrah on behalf of a living person 6424 views Q. I am working in Jubail, K.S.A. Last year I performed Haj along with the Dawah Center of Jubail with Tashree (Permission to Perform Haj from Saudi Government. I had a small doubt i.e. as we are performing Haje-E-Tamattu. We performed Umrah and then they alloted accomodation in Muzadalifa and they are calling as extension mena. during Haj We have to stay in Mena and perform Salah in mena but we are in muzdalifa, so it is permissible to stay in extension mena and offer salah. Please advise what to do. 1581 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 11245 Country: India Title: As salam alaikum, Respected ulama of deoband. My question is regarding umrah. I stay in KSA and i have commit a mistake during umrah i have to give (dum). until now i have not given dum is there any other option insted of dum. And what is the time to give the dum. please explain in detail in the light of quran and hadith. Question: As salam alaikum, Respected ulama of deoband. My question is regarding umrah. I stay in KSA and i have commit a mistake during umrah i have to give (dum). until now i have not given dum is there any other option insted of dum. And what is the time to give the dum. please explain in detail in the light of quran and hadith. Answer ID: 11245 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 301/275=B/1430) It is wajib upon you to offer dum (animal for slaughter). There is no alternate and neither is it specified in any timeframe, you can offer it when you like, but the animal should be slaughtered in Haram only. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
